limitations.en: A source compilation reader for tadpoles. Source attribution, images, uncertain stages and inconsistent ratios retain their separate scopes. Primary-work review, absolute measurement units, current species identity and the remaining scientific facets are incomplete.
limitations.zh: 本页为蝌蚪来源汇编读本。来源归属、图像、未确定阶段和冲突比例分别保留其范围。原始文献审阅、绝对尺寸单位、当前物种身份及其余科学主题尚未完成。

text.en: TadpoleTraits version 4 assigns these source records to Cycloramphus boraceiensis, within Cycloramphus, Cycloramphidae, using Amphibian Species of the World version 6.2 (2024). Names as printed in the underlying works are retained separately: Cycloramphus boraceiensis. This source assignment does not by itself establish equivalence with a current COL26.8 species concept.
text.zh: TadpoleTraits 第 4 版依据 Amphibian Species of the World 6.2 版（2024），将这些来源记录归在 Cycloramphus boraceiensis、Cycloramphus、Cycloramphidae 下。原出版物中的名称单独保留：Cycloramphus boraceiensis。该来源归属本身不足以确定与当前 COL26.8 物种概念等同。

text.en: The compilation contains 14 literature-derived rows and 1 image-derived rows for this source concept. Supplied stage entries are 29; 44; 30; 31; 32; 34; 36; 42; 37; 37-42; 42 (Judging based on the picture). Stage values and any accompanying uncertainty are retained as source labels; stages inferred from pictures are not treated as directly documented developmental observations. Row counts are not unique animal counts, and sample-size fields are not summed across studies.
text.zh: 汇编为该来源概念保留 14 条文献数据行和 1 条图像数据行，提供的阶段条目为 29；44；30；31；32；34；36；42；37；37-42；42 (Judging based on the picture)。阶段值及其相伴不确定性按来源标签保留；由图像推断的阶段不视为直接记录的发育观察。数据行数不等于去重的动物数量，各研究的样本量字段也不跨研究相加。

text.en: The image-data source reports body length / total length = 0.234834 (source row 352, stage 42 (Judging based on the picture)); tail length / total length = 0.768849 (source row 352, stage 42 (Judging based on the picture)); maximum body height / total length = 0.103247 (source row 352, stage 42 (Judging based on the picture)); maximum tail height / total length = 0.0652484 (source row 352, stage 42 (Judging based on the picture)); tail muscle height / total length = 0.0448771 (source row 352, stage 42 (Judging based on the picture)). Values shown here are rounded for readability and are dimensionless source proportions. Images may be drawings or photographs; these values are not direct measurements of a representative wild population. Fields inconsistent with their same-row numerator and total length are excluded.
text.zh: 图像数据来源记载 躯体长度/全长 = 0.234834（来源第 352 行，阶段 42 (Judging based on the picture)）；尾长/全长 = 0.768849（来源第 352 行，阶段 42 (Judging based on the picture)）；躯体最大高度/全长 = 0.103247（来源第 352 行，阶段 42 (Judging based on the picture)）；尾部最大高度/全长 = 0.0652484（来源第 352 行，阶段 42 (Judging based on the picture)）；尾肌高度/全长 = 0.0448771（来源第 352 行，阶段 42 (Judging based on the picture)）。显示值为便于阅读而作舍入，是无量纲的来源比例。图像可能是绘图或照片，这些值不是代表性野生种群的直接测量。有字段与同一行分子及全长不一致时，该字段不写入本节。

text.en: TadpoleTraits version 4 assigns these source records to Nanorana vicina, within Nanorana, Dicroglossidae, using Amphibian Species of the World version 6.2 (2024). Names as printed in the underlying works are retained separately: Nanorana vicina; Paa vicina. This source assignment does not by itself establish equivalence with a current COL26.8 species concept.

text.en: The compilation contains 11 literature-derived rows and 0 image-derived rows for this source concept. Supplied stage entries are 36; 25; 26; 27; 29; 28; 32; 31; 38; 37. Stage values and any accompanying uncertainty are retained as source labels; stages inferred from pictures are not treated as directly documented developmental observations. Row counts are not unique animal counts, and sample-size fields are not summed across studies.

text.en: TadpoleTraits version 4 assigns these source records to Pleurodema cordobae, within Pleurodema, Leptodactylidae, using Amphibian Species of the World version 6.2 (2024). Names as printed in the underlying works are retained separately: Pleurodema cordobae. This source assignment does not by itself establish equivalence with a current COL26.8 species concept.
text.zh: TadpoleTraits 第 4 版依据 Amphibian Species of the World 6.2 版（2024），将这些来源记录归在 Pleurodema cordobae、Pleurodema、Leptodactylidae 下。原出版物中的名称单独保留：Pleurodema cordobae。该来源归属本身不足以确定与当前 COL26.8 物种概念等同。

text.en: The compilation contains 2 literature-derived rows and 0 image-derived rows for this source concept. Supplied stage entries are 35-38; NA. Stage values and any accompanying uncertainty are retained as source labels; stages inferred from pictures are not treated as directly documented developmental observations. Row counts are not unique animal counts, and sample-size fields are not summed across studies.
text.zh: 汇编为该来源概念保留 2 条文献数据行和 0 条图像数据行，提供的阶段条目为 35-38；NA。阶段值及其相伴不确定性按来源标签保留；由图像推断的阶段不视为直接记录的发育观察。数据行数不等于去重的动物数量，各研究的样本量字段也不跨研究相加。

text.en: 5 image-ratio fields for this concept differ from the quotient of their supplied same-row numerator and total length by more than 0.001. limitations.zh: 本页为蝌蚪来源汇编读本。来源归属、图像、未确定阶段和冲突比例分别保留其范围。原始文献审阅、绝对尺寸单位、当前物种身份及其余科学主题尚未完成。

text.en: TadpoleTraits version 4 assigns these source records to Crinia flindersensis, within Crinia, Myobatrachidae, using Amphibian Species of the World version 6.2 (2024). Names as printed in the underlying works are retained separately: Crinia flindersensis. This source assignment does not by itself establish equivalence with a current COL26.8 species concept.
text.zh: TadpoleTraits 第 4 版依据 Amphibian Species of the World 6.2 版（2024），将这些来源记录归在 Crinia flindersensis、Crinia、Myobatrachidae 下。原出版物中的名称单独保留：Crinia flindersensis。该来源归属本身不足以确定与当前 COL26.8 物种概念等同。

text.en: The compilation contains 2 literature-derived rows and 15 image-derived rows for this source concept. Supplied stage entries are NA; 28; 29; 30; 34; 35; 37; 41. Stage values and any accompanying uncertainty are retained as source labels; stages inferred from pictures are not treated as directly documented developmental observations. Row counts are not unique animal counts, and sample-size fields are not summed across studies.
text.zh: 汇编为该来源概念保留 2 条文献数据行和 15 条图像数据行，提供的阶段条目为 NA；28；29；30；34；35；37；41。阶段值及其相伴不确定性按来源标签保留；由图像推断的阶段不视为直接记录的发育观察。数据行数不等于去重的动物数量，各研究的样本量字段也不跨研究相加。

text.en: The image-data source reports body length / total length = 0.371193 (source row 269, stage 28); tail length / total length = 0.633933 (source row 269, stage 28); maximum body height / total length = 0.195142 (source row 269, stage 28); maximum tail height / total length = 0.186748 (source row 269, stage 28); tail muscle height / total length = 0.0713118 (source row 269, stage 28). Values shown here are rounded for readability and are dimensionless source proportions. Images may be drawings or photographs; these values are not direct measurements of a representative wild population. Fields inconsistent with their same-row numerator and total length are excluded.
text.zh: 图像数据来源记载 躯体长度/全长 = 0.371193（来源第 269 行，阶段 28）；尾长/全长 = 0.633933（来源第 269 行，阶段 28）；躯体最大高度/全长 = 0.195142（来源第 269 行，阶段 28）；尾部最大高度/全长 = 0.186748（来源第 269 行，阶段 28）；尾肌高度/全长 = 0.0713118（来源第 269 行，阶段 28）。显示值为便于阅读而作舍入，是无量纲的来源比例。图像可能是绘图或照片，这些值不是代表性野生种群的直接测量。有字段与同一行分子及全长不一致时，该字段不写入本节。

text.en: 36 image-ratio fields for this concept differ from the quotient of their supplied same-row numerator and total length by more than 0.001. Original values and row identifiers are preserved in the source discrepancy ledger. No corrected value is silently substituted, and these conflicting ratios do not support reader conclusions.
text.zh: 该来源概念有 36 个图像比例字段，与同一行所给分子除以全长的结果相差超过 0.001。原值及行号保留在来源差异台账中；没有悄悄替换为修正值，这些冲突比例不支持读者结论。

text.en: TadpoleTraits version 4 assigns these source records to Odontophrynus americanus, within Odontophrynus, Odontophrynidae, using Amphibian Species of the World version 6.2 (2024). Names as printed in the underlying works are retained separately: Odontophrynus achalensis; Odontophrynus americanus; Odontophrynus barrioi; Odontophrynus occidentalis. This source assignment does not by itself establish equivalence with a current COL26.8 species concept.

text.en: The compilation contains 7 literature-derived rows and 2 image-derived rows for this source concept. Supplied stage entries are 28; NA; 38; 37; 26-30; 31-37; 38-41; 31 (Judging based on the picture). Stage values and any accompanying uncertainty are retained as source labels; stages inferred from pictures are not treated as directly documented developmental observations. Row counts are not unique animal counts, and sample-size fields are not summed across studies.

text.en: The image-data source reports body length / total length = 0.329938 (source row 1168, stage 34 (Judging based on the picture)); maximum body height / total length = 0.223385 (source row 1168, stage 34 (Judging based on the picture)); maximum tail height / total length = 0.233531 (source row 1168, stage 34 (Judging based on the picture)). Values shown here are rounded for readability and are dimensionless source proportions. Images may be drawings or photographs; these values are not direct measurements of a representative wild population. Fields inconsistent with their same-row numerator and total length are excluded.

text.en: 5 image-ratio fields for this concept differ from the quotient of their supplied same-row numerator and total length by more than 0.001. Original values and row identifiers are preserved in the source discrepancy ledger. No corrected value is silently substituted, and these conflicting ratios do not support reader conclusions.

text.en: TadpoleTraits version 4 assigns these source records to Phrynobatrachus mababiensis, within Phrynobatrachus, Phrynobatrachidae, using Amphibian Species of the World version 6.2 (2024). Names as printed in the underlying works are retained separately: Phrynobatrachus mababiensis. This source assignment does not by itself establish equivalence with a current COL26.8 species concept.
text.zh: TadpoleTraits 第 4 版依据 Amphibian Species of the World 6.2 版（2024），将这些来源记录归在 Phrynobatrachus mababiensis、Phrynobatrachus、Phrynobatrachidae 下。原出版物中的名称单独保留：Phrynobatrachus mababiensis。该来源归属本身不足以确定与当前 COL26.8 物种概念等同。

text.en: The compilation contains 21 literature-derived rows and 1 image-derived rows for this source concept. Supplied stage entries are NA; 30; 26; uncertainty. Stage values and any accompanying uncertainty are retained as source labels; stages inferred from pictures are not treated as directly documented developmental observations. Row counts are not unique animal counts, and sample-size fields are not summed across studies.
text.zh: 汇编为该来源概念保留 21 条文献数据行和 1 条图像数据行，提供的阶段条目为 NA；30；26；uncertainty。阶段值及其相伴不确定性按来源标签保留；由图像推断的阶段不视为直接记录的发育观察。数据行数不等于去重的动物数量，各研究的样本量字段也不跨研究相加。

text.en: The image-data source reports body length / total length = 0.321964 (source row 1249, stage uncertainty); tail length / total length = 0.675719 (source row 1249, stage uncertainty); maximum body height / total length = 0.165859 (source row 1249, stage uncertainty); maximum tail height / total length = 0.158601 (source row 1249, stage uncertainty); tail muscle height / total length = 0.0757603 (source row 1249, stage uncertainty). Values shown here are rounded for readability and are dimensionless source proportions. Images may be drawings or photographs; these values are not direct measurements of a representative wild population. Fields inconsistent with their same-row numerator and total length are excluded.

limitations.en: A source compilation reader for tadpoles. Source attribution, images, uncertain stages and inconsistent ratios retain their separate scopes. Primary-work review, absolute measurement units, current species identity and the remaining scientific facets are incomplete.
limitations.zh: 本页为蝌蚪来源汇编读本。来源归属、图像、未确定阶段和冲突比例分别保留其范围。原始文献审阅、绝对尺寸单位、当前物种身份及其余科学主题尚未完成。

text.en: TadpoleTraits version 4 assigns these source records to Mixophyes fasciolatus, within Mixophyes, Myobatrachidae, using Amphibian Species of the World version 6.2 (2024). Names as printed in the underlying works are retained separately: Mixophyes fasciolatus. This source assignment does not by itself establish equivalence with a current COL26.8 species concept.
text.zh: TadpoleTraits 第 4 版依据 Amphibian Species of the World 6.2 版（2024），将这些来源记录归在 Mixophyes fasciolatus、Mixophyes、Myobatrachidae 下。原出版物中的名称单独保留：Mixophyes fasciolatus。该来源归属本身不足以确定与当前 COL26.8 物种概念等同。

text.en: The compilation contains 0 literature-derived rows and 5 image-derived rows for this source concept. Supplied stage entries are 28; 39; 27; 37; 36. Stage values and any accompanying uncertainty are retained as source labels; stages inferred from pictures are not treated as directly documented developmental observations. Row counts are not unique animal counts, and sample-size fields are not summed across studies.
text.zh: 汇编为该来源概念保留 0 条文献数据行和 5 条图像数据行，提供的阶段条目为 28；39；27；37；36。阶段值及其相伴不确定性按来源标签保留；由图像推断的阶段不视为直接记录的发育观察。数据行数不等于去重的动物数量，各研究的样本量字段也不跨研究相加。

text.en: The image-data source reports body length / total length = 0.372107 (source row 1048, stage 28); tail length / total length = 0.627648 (source row 1048, stage 28); maximum body height / total length = 0.159381 (source row 1048, stage 28); maximum tail height / total length = 0.169667 (source row 1048, stage 28); tail muscle height / total length = 0.0861189 (source row 1048, stage 28). Values shown here are rounded for readability and are dimensionless source proportions. Images may be drawings or photographs; these values are not direct measurements of a representative wild population. Fields inconsistent with their same-row numerator and total length are excluded.
text.zh: 图像数据来源记载 躯体长度/全长 = 0.372107（来源第 1048 行，阶段 28）；尾长/全长 = 0.627648（来源第 1048 行，阶段 28）；躯体最大高度/全长 = 0.159381（来源第 1048 行，阶段 28）；尾部最大高度/全长 = 0.169667（来源第 1048 行，阶段 28）；尾肌高度/全长 = 0.0861189（来源第 1048 行，阶段 28）。显示值为便于阅读而作舍入，是无量纲的来源比例。图像可能是绘图或照片，这些值不是代表性野生种群的直接测量。有字段与同一行分子及全长不一致时，该字段不写入本节。

text.en: 4 image-ratio fields for this concept differ from the quotient of their supplied same-row numerator and total length by more than 0.001. Original values and row identifiers are preserved in the source discrepancy ledger. No corrected value is silently substituted, and these conflicting ratios do not support reader conclusions.
text.zh: 该来源概念有 4 个图像比例字段，与同一行所给分子除以全长的结果相差超过 0.001。原值及行号保留在来源差异台账中；没有悄悄替换为修正值，这些冲突比例不支持读者结论。

Images may be drawings or photographs; these values are not direct measurements of a representative wild population. Fields inconsistent with their same-row numerator and total length are excluded.

text.en: 4 image-ratio fields for this concept differ from the quotient of their supplied same-row numerator and total length by more than 0.001.
